div.div:
Key Problems:
1. Users register separately on each site
2. Same email creates two different accounts
3. No single sign-on across services
4. Duplicate user data, inconsistent password policies
5. Different hash algorithms (SHA-256 vs MD5)
6. Different DB schemas (users vs members)
